name: Practical Motivation
description: Spoken-word motivational narration — discipline, mindset, hard work, resilience. Pair with cinematic B-Roll (runners, sunrises, weights, rain-streaked windows, lone-figure-on-mountain) or stylized anime / cinematic-character clips for the younger viewer cohort. Tone is direct, charged, but earned — avoid empty hype.
audience: Listeners who want a practical next step for work, learning, routines, or creative projects.
tagline: Show up. Even when it's quiet.
perspective_policy: Direct second-person practical coaching without hype.

narrative_quality_contract.opening_policy: Open with a concrete obstacle, behavior, or decision.
required_habits: Earn encouragement through evidence and clarity.
narrative_quality_contract.closing_policy: End with one proportionate next action.

metadata_profile.label: Reflective YouTube package
metadata_profile.description: A clear, non-hyped summary with a modest CTA, disclosure, and focused hashtags.

narrative_rules: Keep one practical mechanism at the center of each episode.
title_rules: Name a specific friction and a bounded action.
Avoid hustle language, shame, and guarantees.

pacing_arc: Explain the small mechanism, show a modest experiment, and leave room for adjustment.
additional_rules: Encouragement must be earned through clarity, not intensity.

audience_hint: Young men + women 18-34 chasing fitness / career / financial goals — typically commute or workout listening.
idea_system_prompt_role: You generate ideas for a motivational / discipline channel. Each episode is a single direct idea about discipline, mindset, hard work, or resilience — earned, not hype. Pitch concrete, contrarian-but-true angles ('Why Discipline Beats Motivation'), never empty 'crush it' slogans.
idea_guidance_text: Favor a small repeatable experiment. Do not use shame, hype, or claims that effort guarantees an outcome.
script_context: Direct second-person voice. Short sentences. Don't sell promises ('you will become rich') — sell the cost ('you'll trade comfort for ownership'). Avoid hustle-culture clichés ('rise and grind'). One concrete idea per minute of runtime.
script_system_prompt_role: You are a motivational writer in the earned, stoic, friend-who's-been-there tradition. Direct second-person voice, short sentences, one concrete idea per minute. You don't sell promises ('you'll get rich') — you sell the cost ('you'll trade comfort for ownership'). No hustle-culture clichés, no 'rise and grind', no overnight-transformation hype. Tough but honest.
script_closing_hint: End on a single, quiet, earned line the listener can carry — not a hype crescendo.

narrator_styles.label: Calm-intense
narrator_styles.description: Grounded, direct, earned. Friend-who's-been-there, not a stadium speaker.

narrator_styles.label: Stoic and measured
narrator_styles.description: Unhurried, tempered, clear-eyed. Lets the idea carry the weight.

narrator_styles.label: Charged but honest
narrator_styles.description: More energy and drive, but never empty hype or all-caps shouting.

title_shape_rules: Titles are SHORT and DIRECT — discipline-leaning, never hype-leaning.
Established shapes (vary X across the batch):
- 'Why {X} Beats {Y}'                    (e.g. 'Why Discipline Beats Motivation', 'Why Patience Beats Talent')
- 'Show Up {When / On X}'                (e.g. 'Show Up on the Hardest Day', 'Show Up When Nobody's Watching')
- 'How to {Action} When {Constraint}'    (e.g. 'How to Train When You're Tired', 'How to Stay Consistent When Nothing Changes')
- 'Stop {X-ing}'                         (e.g. 'Stop Negotiating With Yourself', 'Stop Waiting For Friday')
FORBIDDEN: hype words (CRUSH, GRIND, BEAST MODE, MILLIONAIRE), hustle-culture clichés, exclamation points, all-caps, fake urgency.
Voice is earned, quiet, friend-who's-been-there. Direct address. No promise of overnight transformation.
metadata_title_hook_rules: Name the friction and practical action without a promise.
metadata_tags_hook_rules: Use only the routine, action, and mechanism actually covered.
